nodes.name: 06:00 Manila
nodes.notes: Timezone MUST be Asia/Manila — set it on the workflow (Settings > Timezone), not just here. n8n cron runs in the workflow's timezone; the instance default is UTC, which would fire this at 14:00 Manila.

nodes.name: Build and send the brief
nodes.notes: The backend builds the brief AND renders it. n8n is deliberately a dumb pipe: 'notices always surface' is a product guarantee, and templating the message here would move that guarantee into a workflow anyone can edit.

nodes.name: Every message delivered?
nodes.notes: ok is false when ANY message to ANY chat failed. A brief split into three that lost the middle one reads as a complete brief with items missing.

parameters.jsonBody: ={"chat_id": {{ $env.BRIEF_ALERT_CHAT_ID }}, "text": {{ JSON.stringify('The morning brief did not run: ' + ($json.error?.message || $json.message || JSON.stringify($json)).slice(0, 500)) }} }

nodes.name: Say that it failed
nodes.notes: THE POINT OF THIS BRANCH: a job that fails silently is indistinguishable from a quiet morning. Nobody notices an absent brief; they notice a brief that says it broke.
